stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

name: arc-outlined-box-checker-fill
description: Use when ARC grids show hollow colored rectangles and sparse outside markers. Preserve frames and checkerboard-fill each interior with its associated marker color.
---

# Outlined boxes with checkerboard fills

Use for ARC-style grids containing one or more hollow rectangular frames, sparse colored cells outside them, and blank frame interiors.

## Rule

- Preserve each outlined rectangular frame in its original color and location.
- Identify the sparse marker color associated with each frame. The markers may be scattered anywhere outside the boxes; they indicate the fill color, rather than being retained as output noise.
- Fill only the interior cells of each box with that marker color in a checkerboard pattern: a cell is colored when `(row + column) % 2` has the same parity as the top-left interior cell. This makes opposite colors/blank cells alternate horizontally and vertically.
- Set all cells outside the frames to background color 0, including the scattered markers.
- Keep the original grid dimensions.

## Applying demonstrations

A typical demonstration shows each frame's blank interior becoming an alternating checkerboard of a color found in sparse outside cells. Use the demo to confirm the parity phase and which marker color maps to which frame when multiple boxes/colors occur. For each frame, checkerboard phase may be anchored independently at its top-left interior cell.

## Validation

Before submitting, check that each frame remains intact, no interior cells are left with unrelated colors, checkerboard neighbors alternate, all non-frame exterior cells are zero, and the output dimensions match the input.",
